notes: Name-internal kind words ('River Frasin', 'Straja River') and the static 'in Romania' follow the Kestrel-River and Thornmere templates exactly. 'tributary of' is routed to the genitive rule as the instruction set directs, but the part/component test is a real judgment call there - a tributary is a component of a river system rather than of the named river, so the opaque Possession branch may be the safer reading than PartOf.
